parameters.code: var world=Survivor.Combat.BattleWorld.Instance; var target=world.Pickups.Pool.Items.Where(p=>p.IsRented).OrderBy(p=>((UnityEngine.Vector2)(p.transform.position-world.Player.transform.position)).sqrMagnitude).FirstOrDefault(); var keys=new System.Collections.Generic.List<UnityEngine.InputSystem.Key>(); if(target!=null) { var delta=target.transform.position-world.Player.transform.position; if(UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(delta.x)>0.5f) keys.Add(delta.x>0?UnityEngine.InputSystem.Key.D:UnityEngine.InputSystem.Key.A); if(UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(delta.y)>0.5f) keys.Add(delta.y>0?UnityEngine.InputSystem.Key.W:UnityEngine.InputSystem.Key.S); } var keyboard=(UnityEngine.InputSystem.Keyboard)UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputSystem.devices.First(d=>d.name=="M3Keyboard"); UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputSystem.QueueStateEvent(keyboard,new UnityEngine.InputSystem.LowLevel.KeyboardState(keys.ToArray())); UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputSystem.Update(); return new { target=target==null?null:target.transform.position.ToString(), movement=keys.Select(k=>k.ToString()).ToArray(), drops=world.Pickups.Pool.ActiveCount, xp=Survivor.Core.GameFlow.Instance.Session.Run.Experience };
